questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which of the following compounds is metallic and ferromagnetic ?
questions.explanation: Out of all the four given metallic oxides <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.339ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="5.454ex" height="1.934ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 2410.6 855" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(760,0)"><use data-c="1D45F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D45F"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(1211,0)"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D442" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D442"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(796,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is attracted by magnetic field very strongly. The effect persists even when the magnetic field is removed. Thus <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: -0.339ex;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="5.454ex" height="1.934ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -705 2410.6 855" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D436" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D436"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mi" transform="translate(760,0)"><use data-c="1D45F" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D45F"></use></g><g data-mml-node="TeXAtom" data-mjx-texclass="ORD" transform="translate(1211,0)"><g data-mml-node="msub"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="1D442" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-I-1D442"></use></g><g data-mml-node="mn" transform="translate(796,-150) scale(0.707)"><use data-c="32" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-32"></use></g></g></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container> is metallic and ferromagnetic in nature.
